title: Cross-team spot-check tracker (April 2025)
content:
Purpose:
This is a light-weight, single-tab tracker used for quick cross-team spot-checks, runbook readiness, and small one-off actions that come up during launches or incident warm-ups. Not intended to replace project trackers (Jira/Linear) — use for status at-a-glance in async standups and ad-hoc syncs.

How to use:
- Add a new row for each check/action, assign an owner and a target date.
- Update 'Status' and 'Last update' when there is meaningful progress.
- Color-coding convention (manual): RED = blocked, YELLOW = needs follow-up, GREEN = ready.
- Weekly reviewer: rotate between SRE and Product Ops.

Sheet (columns):
Item | Owner | Team | Category | Priority | Est hrs | Status | Target date | Last update | Notes | Link
----|----|----|----|----:|----:|----|----|----|----|----
Runbook: private-deploy smoke test | Marcus Chen | sre | runbook | high | 3 | in_progress | 2025-04-07 | 2025-04-08 | add steps for KMS case | https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/private-smoke
Billing alert sanity check | Elena Park | platform-engineering | alerting | medium | 1 | done | 2025-04-03 | 2025-04-03 | threshold calibrated for p95 token rate | https://internal.redwood.ai/dashboards/billing
Demo dataset scrub | Priya Nair | product-hosted-api | data | low | 2 | blocked | 2025-04-10 | 2025-04-02 | waiting on legal review (ENG-4201) | ENG-4201
Dedicated node capacity estimate (NA) | Diego Alvarez | infra | capacity | high | 4 | in_review | 2025-04-09 | 2025-04-09 | need final GPU sku list from procurement | https://sheets.redwood.ai/procurement/dedicated-nodes
SLA playbook checklist | Asha Rao | customer-success | documentation | high | 5 | needs_follow_up | 2025-04-15 | 2025-04-08 | missing escalation contacts for EMEA | https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CS/SLA-playbook
Demo cluster network policy | Marcus Chen | private-deployments | security | medium | 2 | done | 2025-04-04 | 2025-04-04 | vetted by security, recorded in runbook | https://github.com/redwood-inference/network-configs/pull/47
Oncall rotation quick swap | Elena Park | site-reliability-engineering | staffing | medium | 0.5 | done | 2025-04-05 | 2025-04-05 | swap processed, calendar updated | calendar:ops-oncall@redwood.ai
Model quantization smoke note | Priya Nair | applied-ml | validation | low | 1 | in_progress | 2025-04-11 | 2025-04-09 | small quality delta observed on 4-bit path | https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/issues/88

Ad-hoc tallies (manual):
- Total items: 8
- By status: done=3, in_progress=3, blocked=1, needs_follow_up=1
- By priority: high=3, medium=3, low=2
- Estimated effort remaining (hrs, sum of non-done rows): 3+4+5+1+2 = 15 hrs (approx)

Quick observations (Apr 10):
- Bottleneck: legal review is delaying the Demo dataset scrub (blocked). Recommend product-hosted-api escalate with legal and provide minimal scrubbed subset to allow demos to proceed.
- Capacity note: Dedicated node capacity estimate shows uncertainty on SKU mix; procurement expect answers by 2025-04-11. If SKU requires more budget, push non-critical infra tickets to next sprint.
- Runbook readiness: Most runbook checks are in progress or done; add explicit KMS key rotation step to private smoke test to avoid gaps during customer onboarding.

Next steps / owners
- Marcus: finish private-deploy smoke test + add KMS step (target 2025-04-10).
- Diego: confirm GPU SKU list and update capacity estimate (target 2025-04-11).
- Priya: follow up with Legal on demo dataset scrub and report by 2025-04-12.
- Elena: maintain weekly pull for 'Billing alert sanity check' and update thresholds if usage pattern changes.

Revision log (short):
- 2025-04-02 created by Asha Rao as one-tab sheet for quick checks.
- 2025-04-04 Marcus added network policy and runbook row.
- 2025-04-08 Asha added SLA playbook checklist and tagged EMEA follow-up.
- 2025-04-09 Diego uploaded capacity note and updated status to in_review.
- 2025-04-10 this consolidated snapshot saved for async review.

Notes to reviewers: Keep changes light-touch. If the item grows beyond a single-owner action or requires multi-week work, move to Jira and note the ticket in 'Link'.
